chunks: Ignore this affair, O Joseph; and you, O woman, ask forgiveness for your sin, for you were surely errant.

key_terms.الْخَاطِئِينَ: The errant / Those who make mistakes

ai.seo_question: What did the wife of Al-Aziz and Prophet Joseph do after the seduction attempt?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Yusuf (AS) is commanded to turn away from the immediate temptation, while the wife of Al-Aziz is urged to seek forgiveness, marking a pivotal moment of repentance in the narrative. Shia exegetes often highlight the dual nature of this address, emphasizing Yusuf's steadfastness in divine command and the woman's acknowledgment of her fault as a model for sincere tawbah. This incident underscores the virtue of maintaining chastity amidst power and wealth, a key theme in the story of Yusuf.
